en.title: Cyberpunk 2077 Edgerunners Update Hits Switch 2 With Major Glitches
en.summary: A highly anticipated update for Cyberpunk 2077, tied to the Edgerunners anime, has launched on the Nintendo Switch 2. Unfortunately, early reports indicate a rough start, with players experiencing significant technical issues.
en.body:
Last week, CD Projekt Red celebrated the success of the *Cyberpunk: Edgerunners* anime by releasing a significant in-game update for **Cyberpunk 2077**. This new patch, often referred to as the 'Edgerunners 2' update, aims to bring new content and improvements inspired by the popular Netflix series. However, for players on the Nintendo Switch 2, the launch has been far from smooth sailing.

Reports have flooded in from the community detailing a host of frustrating problems plaguing the game since the update went live. Issues range from frequent game crashes that bring the experience to an abrupt halt, to frustrating loading bugs that prevent players from progressing. Performance has also taken a hit, with many users reporting stuttering and frame rate drops that make navigating Night City a chore. Compounding these problems are profile and save glitches, which have left some players unable to access their progress or characters at all. The severity of these issues has led some to declare the Nintendo version of **Cyberpunk 2077** "unplayable" following this latest patch, a stark contrast to the intended premium experience.

## A Rocky Launch for Night City on Switch

CD Projekt Red has made significant strides in revitalizing **Cyberpunk 2077** since its notoriously troubled launch in 2020. Through a series of substantial patches and the **Phantom Liberty** expansion, the game has evolved into the ambitious RPG it was always meant to be. The **Edgerunners** update was intended to be another feather in its cap, bringing elements of the beloved anime into the game world. The decision to bring this updated experience to the Nintendo Switch 2 was met with excitement, offering a new platform for players to dive into Night City. However, the current state of the port suggests that the optimization process may have been rushed or encountered unforeseen difficulties, leading to a user experience that falls far short of expectations, especially for a platform that prides itself on stability and performance.

## Community Disappointment and Frustration

Understandably, the **Cyberpunk 2077** community on the Switch 2 is expressing significant disappointment. For many, this was their first entry into the world of **Cyberpunk**, or a chance to revisit it with new content. The current state of the game, marred by crashes and bugs, not only hinders enjoyment but also raises questions about the quality assurance process for this particular platform. Fans who were eager to experience the **Edgerunners** content are now stuck troubleshooting, with some even considering abandoning the game until further patches address the critical issues. The hope was for a seamless integration of the update, but the reality has been a frustrating barrier to entry, leaving many questioning the future of **Cyberpunk 2077** on the Nintendo hardware.

## What's Next for the Switch 2 Version

CD Projekt Red has yet to issue a formal statement regarding the specific issues on the Nintendo Switch 2 version of **Cyberpunk 2077**. Players are advised to keep an eye on official **Cyberpunk 2077** social media channels and support pages for any upcoming announcements or patches. The developer's track record suggests they will likely address these problems, but the timeline for a fix remains unclear at this moment.
